periods.time: Just before D-block first-round match against Amane
periods.location: Osaka Bay Dome spectator/contestant area; Yakushi General Hospital by phone
periods.summary: Kiriko Yakushi forfeits her match against Amane when every inpatient at her hospital simultaneously falls into critical condition.
periods.cause: Amane wishes not to fight Kiriko; his Excessive Goddess's Favor creates a chain of events that removes her from the tournament.
periods.process: Amane casually says he will not fight Kiriko. Immediately afterward Kiriko receives an emergency call from Deputy Director Kajihara: every inpatient has suddenly worsened and hospital staff cannot identify the cause or cope with the scale. Kiriko recognizes this cannot be a mass misdiagnosis and orders a helicopter.
periods.outcome: Kiriko withdraws from Seven Stars and leaves to save her patients; Amane advances without fighting.
periods.aftermath: The impossible coincidence becomes crucial evidence for Ikki's conclusion that Amane creates wished-for futures rather than seeing them.
casualties: All Yakushi General Hospital inpatients placed in sudden critical danger
periods.significance: Demonstrates Amane's ability through collateral harm and removes one of the tournament's major contenders without combat.
